turns.text:
bestie its almost midnight and i should be asleep already but im still stewing over this text lol
karina left me on seen for like 2 hrs today when i asked about the chem lab question. she said later she was just doing homework but like... ngl i still feel weird
can u make this sound chill and not desperate pls

"hey sorry if this is random but did u figure out number 4 on the lab?? also ur not mad at me right?? lol. anyway we're still sitting together at lunch in ms tolentinos room B12 w eli tmrw right"

Happy to help. Your draft is already pretty close, it just has a few too many question marks and the "not mad at me right??" part is the bit that could read as worried. Here's a more relaxed version:

"hey, did you figure out number 4 on the lab? I got stuck on the setup. also still on for lunch in B12 with Eli tomorrow 🙂"

I dropped the "you're not mad" line because asking about the lab and confirming lunch already says everything's normal. If you want to keep a little check-in, here's a lighter option:

"hey, did you figure out number 4 on the lab? also all good on your end? lunch in B12 with Eli tomorrow still happening 🙂"

Which one feels more like you?

ok the first one lol. u think its chill enough tho? like she did leave me on seen
but she said she was doing hw so its prob fine ay no im overthinking

Yes, it's chill. It's casual, it asks a normal question, and it sounds like two people who sit together at lunch. Since she already told you she was doing homework, there's nothing you need to smooth over. People often read a message and then get pulled away before replying.

If you want one extra touch of warmth without making it a big deal, you could add "no rush!" after the lab question:

"hey, did you figure out number 4 on the lab? I got stuck on the setup, no rush! also still on for lunch in B12 with Eli tomorrow 🙂"

Then send it and get some sleep.

ok sending that one
i'll also tell the lab rats chat its sorted so eli doesnt think im ghosting too lol
ty bestie 😭
Sounds like a plan. Once you hear back, a quick "all sorted, thanks!" in the group chat will wrap it up. Good luck with lab number 4, and goodnight! 🌙
